source_policy: Only individually documented CC0 recordings, plus original Nodus radio synthesis. No Moodist audio bytes reused. FSD50K compilation attribution retained separately.
ratings_policy: Prefer highest-rated semantically fitting candidate within reviewed results. BigSoundBank sorted n (highest to least rated), ratings snapshot 2026-10-09. FSD50K PP/PNP ratings measure labels, not sound quality; no fabricated community score.
